panels.description: Process state reported by the panel, not a connectivity probe. Only the active state is displayed. Missing or unknown state remains No data.

panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the exporter; independent of upstream collection success.
panels.title: Prometheus target

panels.description: Successful / present sources. Numeric value is the success fraction, used for color. With the upcoming exporter all three source rows are always present. Older exporters may expose fewer sources. No data when the target is down. API: settings/status; gRPC: runtime outbounds/balancers; expvars: traffic, memory/GC and observation.

targets.expr:
(sum(xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}) / count(xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}))
* on() group_left(summary)
label_join(
  count_values("healthy", sum(xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"}))
  * on() group_left(total)
  count_values("total", count(xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"})),
  "summary", "/", "healthy", "total"
)
and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

panels.description:
Available: Balancers with a usable selected target or configured fallback according to the exporter. This is structural availability, not an end-to-end Internet probe. Includes balancers currently using fallback. Open availability history for detail.

Unavailable: Balancers without an available selected target or usable fallback. A nonzero value calls for investigation. Open availability history.

Fallback: Balancers currently using their fallback. This can preserve service while primary selection is empty. A warning about operating mode, not necessarily an outage. Absent fallback metrics remain No data.

Override: Balancers currently using a manually overridden target. This is an operating mode, not automatically a failure. Open selected outbounds to identify the affected balancer.
panels.title: Balancers

targets.expr: sum(xui_balancer_outbound_available{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 1) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(xui_balancer_outbound_selected{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",role="fallback"}) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(xui_balancer_outbound_selected{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",role="override"}) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(xui_balancer_outbound_available{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="api"} == 1 and on(instance,job) xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="grpc"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

panels.description: Above zero: available balancers, including those served by fallback. Below zero: unavailable balancers and active fallback, stacked as independent attention indicators. These are not a partition: an available balancer can also use fallback, so do not subtract the lower stack from the upper one. Override is shown separately in the summary. Counts describe sampled states, not replacement events or outage duration. Missing source data produces gaps. Open selected outbounds to identify the affected balancer.
panels.title: Balancers · Availability and attention

panels.description:
UP: Observed outbounds that are alive and, when burst probe samples exist, have no failed samples. This is the observation population, not all configured outbounds.

DEGRADED: Alive observed outbounds with failed samples in the current burst observation window. They can still carry traffic. Ordinary observatory does not provide this degradation detail.

DOWN: Observed outbounds reported not alive. Open outbound health for tags and timing. An observation result does not by itself prove which traffic was affected.
panels.title: Observed outbounds

targets.expr: sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 2) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 1) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

sum(((xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * (1 + (xui_observatory_outbound_probe_failed_samples{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == bool 0))) or (xui_observatory_outbound_alive{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} * 2)) == bool 0) and on() (xui_exporter_scrape_success{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}",source="expvars"} == 1) and on() (up{job="xui-exporter",instance="${instance}"} == 1)

panels.description: Above zero: UP outbounds. Below zero: DEGRADED and DOWN, stacked. These three states partition the observed population at each sample; their absolute counts sum to the number of observed outbounds. DEGRADED requires burst probe samples. Missing observations or failed collection produce gaps, never healthy zeroes. Open outbound health to see tags, latency and quality.
panels.title: Observed outbounds · Health history

panels.description: Current open network sockets reported by the panel environment
panels.title: Connection stats

panels.description: Above zero: client download throughput (downlink rate into inbounds). Below zero: client upload throughput (uplink rate into inbounds). Stated in bits per second. Missing or disabled counters remain absent. Open detail views to inspect individual inbound channels.
panels.title: Total traffic · Download / Upload

panels.description: DOWN: Xray alive=0. DEGRADED: burst window contains failed probes. UP: alive with no failed probes; ordinary observatory exposes only alive. Missing data stays missing.
panels.title: Outbound health

panels.description: DOWN: Xray alive=0. DEGRADED: burst window contains failed probes. UP: alive with no failed probes; ordinary observatory exposes only alive. Missing data stays missing.
panels.title: Current outbound health

panels.description: P50/P95 are percentiles of observed window means, not individual HTTP requests. Probe success is a sample-weighted estimate over overlapping observation windows, not a count of unique probes.
panels.title: Outbound quality metrics

panels.description: Dashboard heuristic, not the score used by Xray leastLoad. Burst-only reliability inputs are absent for ordinary observatory. No missing values are filled with zero.
panels.title: Outbound quality score

panels.description: Burst: mean RTT of successful samples in the observation window. Ordinary observatory: last successful delay. Seconds; no fabricated values on failure.
panels.title: Outbound latency

panels.description: Minimum and maximum successful RTT in the current burst window. Not available for ordinary observatory.
panels.title: Burst RTT range

panels.description: Failed fraction in the current burst window, not a cumulative counter. Empty measurements remain absent.
panels.title: Burst failed probes

panels.description: Fraction of observed samples in which a target was selected, not its share of traffic. Multiple selected targets can sum above 100%. Missing scrapes do not count as zero.
panels.title: Outbound selected time

panels.description: Number of observed 0/1 transitions across primary, fallback and override series in each minute. One target replacement can cause multiple transitions. Missing data and minute boundaries limit completeness; this is not a connection log. The window is centered on each minute; the latest bucket is incomplete.
panels.title: Selection state changes

panels.description: Primary target membership plus fallback and override activity. Fallback uses its configured outbound tag; override has no outbound tag. Gray means confirmed inactive; gaps mean unavailable or unknown data.
panels.title: Selected outbounds

panels.description: A selected target or fallback resolves to a runtime outbound. Structural availability, not a test of internet access.
panels.title: Balancer outbound availability

panels.description: Number of selected primary targets only. A successfully observed empty selection is zero; missing or unsupported selection data is absent. Fallback and override are excluded.
panels.title: Selected target count

panels.description: Go runtime memory values; neither is process RSS.
panels.title: Go runtime memory

panels.description: GC pause seconds per elapsed second, displayed as a percentage.
panels.title: GC pause time

panels.description: Remote cluster node availability history over time. Green indicates online based on master panel heartbeat probes; red indicates offline. Missing data indicates collection failure or unconfigured nodes.
panels.title: Availability history

panels.description: Round-trip time (RTT) between master panel and remote cluster nodes. Based on master panel heartbeat probes. Missing data indicates offline nodes or heartbeat probe timeout.
panels.title: Latency

panels.description: Inventory of remote cluster nodes: Xray core process state, system uptime, configured inbounds, and software versions.
panels.title: Inventory

panels.description: Remote cluster node CPU and memory utilization percent over time. Missing data indicates offline nodes.
panels.title: Resources

panels.description: Settings and server/status requests start in parallel. gRPC and expvars start after settings completes, without waiting for server/status. Source durations overlap and are shown without stacking. API is the elapsed span until both API requests finish, not their sum. Runtime is max(gRPC, expvars). Total is the end-to-end duration measured by Prometheus; source durations cannot be added to reconstruct it.
panels.title: Collection duration

panels.description: Resident Set Size (RSS) memory from OS process stats and live Go heap allocations.
panels.title: Exporter process memory

panels.description: Process CPU utilization rate and active Go runtime goroutines.
panels.title: Exporter CPU & Goroutines
